description: Base UMaterials of the scene palette's colours, for runtime spawns (spec 7.1: Project AirSim's setMaterial loads only a base UMaterial; the palette's MI_* instances spawn grey). Not in assets/registry.json until the editor has made them: autofly_ue5/scenes/ue/create_runtime_materials.py creates them (scripts/ue_editor_run.py), and scripts/apply_runtime_materials.py merges these entries once its report shows each one made, base-class, the right colour and compiled (docs/runbook-targets.md).
